'previous_shot: null', 'carry_over: []'; first image of the prop and the character, stated in 'ref'.
Spec mode. Format and aspect noted: '9:16', claymation, hero still.

Two ambiguous readings. (a) 'left foot', 'right toe', 'left arm swinging back', 'right arm swinging forward' do not say whether left and right are the figure's or the frame's. With the figure facing the bottom of the frame, its left is the frame's right, and a model reads the frame's left. (b) The view is 'straight from above (head top and shoulders visible, no face)', yet the contact points are two feet. A pure top view hides the feet under the body, and the spec never says how the feet and toe show.

FL-11: 'instances: 1' + 'no second figure' + a foot-on-card physics line. FL-06: 'head top and shoulders visible, no face'. FL-01/FL-10: no text anywhere. FL-02: each card's structure is described. FL-13: 'everywhere lower than 52% only plain ground' leaves the bottom corner empty.
